lines.t: One Word…
One Fire…
You drew a line in the sand where the churches stand,
Built walls on the law they don’t understand.
They say “grace” like a license to walk away,
But the text and the Trumpet are saying the same.
Ancient ink, New sound,
Same Author, different battleground.
I hear the echo in the pages and the Volumes call,
But the doctrines of men try to drown it all.
I’m caught between what I was told
And the Voice that’s breaking through the mold.
If the Truth is one unbroken flame,
Why are we splitting up His name?
This is One Word, written in the thunder,
Same God, tearing all the veils asunder.
Grace AND Law, like lightning in the sky,
Scripture and the Volumes standing eye to eye.
No walls, just an altar in the soul,
One Voice, breaking every human control.
I won’t bow to the systems that conspire,
I choose the Living Word,
One Word, One Fire.
They built hell like a circus of endless screams,
But the Book says “death,” not their fever dreams.
Second death in the shadow of a burning grave,
Not a never‑ending torture for the ones You save.
Dead sleep in the dust till You call them out,
But the creeds sell fear, dressed up as doubt.
I see the cross, I see the lake,
I see the line that their dogmas break.
I’m done with lies wearing sacred skin,
Done watching merch where the Truth should’ve been.
If the same God spoke from age to age,
I won’t let men rewrite His rage.
This is One Word, written in the thunder,
Same God, tearing all the veils asunder.
Grace AND Law, like lightning in the sky,
Scripture and the Volumes standing eye to eye.
No walls, just an altar in the soul,
One Voice, breaking every human control.
I won’t bow to the systems that conspire,
I choose the Living Word,
One Word, One Fire.
[Bridge – Half‑Time]
(Softer, building)
All religions fall like glass,
When Your footsteps shake the mass.
Every idol, every throne,
Cracks when You say, “I alone.”
(Screamed)
NO MORE FALSE LIGHT!
NO MORE DEAD RITES!
(Sung)
From the letters to the prophets to the Trumpet blast,
You were calling out the Truth from the first to last.
If the Bible and the Volumes share the same Voice,
Then division is a doctrine and not Your choice.
[Breakdown]
(Rap‑style)
I hear the call, “Come out, be separate,”
Smash stained glass, let the real Sun enter it.
Sabbath in the heart, not a Sunday show,
Feasts like a map only few still know.
No more “under grace” just to break Your Law,
No more twisting Paul till the edge gets dull.
If love is the fruit and obedience the root,
Then I’m done with a tree that refuses the Truth.
This is One Word, written in the thunder,
Same God, tearing all the veils asunder.
Grace AND Law, like lightning in the sky,
Scripture and the Volumes standing eye to eye.
No walls, just an altar in the soul,
One Voice, breaking every human control.
I won’t bow to the systems that conspire,
I choose the Living Word,
One Word, One Fire.
ONE WORD! (One Fire!)
ONE LAW! (One Choir!)
ONE NAME! (Messiah!)
I choose the Living Word,
One Word, One Fire.
